subject: Replicating a MIMIC model with ordinal outcomes using summary statistics

messages.author: 36bb4216bf88ac1c
messages.subject: Replicating a MIMIC model with ordinal outcomes using summary statistics
parts:
Hello all,

I have a MIMIC model with one latent factor and ordinal indicators. Parameters are estimated using DWLS (estimator='wlsmv'). Unfortunately, I cannot provide the raw data for this study but, if possible, would like to provide enough information that others could replicate the model. Here is an example of the kind of model I ran using the Holzinger-Swineford data provided with the lavaan package:

hs <- HolzingerSwineford1939[, 1:10] 

hs[,7:10] <- lapply(HolzingerSwineford1939[,7:10], cut, 4, labels=FALSE) 

model <- '
eta =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4
eta ~ sex
'

summary( model.fit <- sem( model, data = hs, estimator ='wlsmv', 
                           ordered = c('x1','x2','x3','x4' ) ) )

( model1.sampstat <- inspect( model.fit, 'sampstat' ) )
( model1.wls.v <- inspect( model.fit, 'wls.v' ) )

Here are my questions:

1) Is it possible to replicate this model from summary statistics (covariance matrix, WLS weight vector, means, etc.)? 
2) If so, can we do this with lavaan? There's a nice example of how to use covariance matrixes as input with continuous outcomes on the lavaan website, but not sure if it's possible with this kind of model. 

Thanks,

-steve
